question: Should OpenClaw show this generic Discord delivery guard when a Discord `message_tool_only` or response-owed turn has activity but no confirmed current-source visible reply?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and privacy-preserving because it does not publish private final text, but it deliberately changes existing documented silence/private-failure behavior into a visible channel message.

options.title: Accept Scoped Discord Guard
options.body: Approve the generic Discord guard for the covered no-visible-reply cases and land once exact-head CI and mergeability are acceptable.

options.title: Narrow Guard Scope
options.body: Ask the contributor to limit the guard to directly addressed `message_tool_only` Discord turns and leave non-mentioned or non-message-tool-only response-owed activity unchanged.

options.title: Defer To Broader Recovery
options.body: Pause this PR until broader stranded-final or durable fallback work defines the permanent cross-channel policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Discord Guard
recommendation.body: Approve the generic Discord guard for the covered no-visible-reply cases and land once exact-head CI and mergeability are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the closest merged strict `message_tool_only` baseline that this PR adjusts around.
